description:
# **Private Shark Watching Charter**

**Citizen Science · Families, Groups & Teams**

A private **boat-based shark watching and citizen-science charter** for families, corporate teams, and small groups. This 6-hour offshore expedition is led by a shark researcher, with an onboard briefing focused on shark ecology, conservation, and responsible wildlife observation.

Your group will travel aboard our low-profile Zodiac to search for pelagic sharks off San Diego, while observing, photographing, and helping document sharks and other offshore wildlife from the boat.

This is a **no-take, observation-based experience** designed for guests who want a safe, ethical, and educational way to encounter sharks without entering the water.

## **Experience Highlights**

* Private charter for **4 to 6 guests**
* USCG-licensed captain
* Shark researcher onboard
* Family, group, and team friendly
* Suitable for ages **7+**
* Onboard shark ecology briefing
* Low-profile Zodiac expedition vessel
* Boat-based photography and observation
* Underwater video options when conditions allow
* Citizen-science data collection
* No touching, handling, feeding, or take

## **Duration**

**6 hours**

## **About**

This private expedition is designed for guests who want a deeper, more meaningful offshore wildlife experience. Your shark researcher will introduce your group to the biology, behavior, and conservation status of pelagic sharks, then guide onboard observations throughout the trip.

When sharks are encountered, guests may help document behavior, photograph individuals, record observations, and contribute to ongoing citizen-science efforts. Sightings may include **blue sharks, mako sharks**, and other offshore marine life.

This is a true open-ocean experience. Shark sightings are not guaranteed, but every trip supports responsible observation, education, and conservation.

## **Who Can Join**

* Families, private groups, corporate teams, and small organizations
* Ages **7+**
* No scuba or snorkeling experience required
* Guests should be comfortable on a small offshore vessel
* Moderate physical fitness is recommended

## **Departure Location**

**Hyatt Mission Bay Marina, San Diego**
Exact meeting instructions and boarding details will be sent by email after booking.

## **What’s Included**

* Private 6-hour shark watching charter
* USCG-licensed captain
* Shark researcher onboard
* Ecology and conservation briefing
* Boat-based shark observation
* Citizen-science documentation support
* Healthy snacks and beverages
* Small group experience aboard our Zodiac expedition vessel

## **Pricing**

### **Base Charter**

Up to 4 guests · 6-hour private watching charter
**$2,600**

### **Each Additional Guest**

5th and 6th passenger
**+$650 per guest**

### **Captain Honorarium**

Paid directly to the captain
**+$300**

## **What to Bring**

* Warm layers
* Windbreaker or waterproof jacket
* Sunglasses and hat
* Reef-safe sunscreen
* Camera or binoculars
* Seasickness medication if needed
* Lunch

## **Good to Know**

This is a private, boat-based wildlife expedition. Guests do not enter the water.

Because this experience takes place in the open ocean, sightings and conditions can vary. We monitor the forecast closely and may recommend adjustments when needed for safety and the best possible experience.

All participants must complete a waiver prior to boarding.

## **Exclusions**

* Captain honorarium
* Gratuities
* Lunch
* Personal camera equipment
* Seasickness medication
